verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own auto-transfer rules: it moves funds between accounts by dollar amount or percentage, and sweeps excess cash from operating accounts into savings. A community user confirms the automatic partitioning works. However, the evidence never shows a threshold-triggered top-up that refills an account when it runs low, and it never mentions low-balance alerts, so only half the story is covered. missing for 10: threshold-based auto top-up into a low account, low-balance alerts or notifications, docs detailing rule triggers and configuration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts

citations.quote: Automate transfers from one to multiple accounts using dollar amounts or percentages.
Relay’s auto-transfer rules make it easy by moving your excess cash out of operating accounts and into savings for you.
Build a cash cushion with high-yield accounts and automated rules that help you stay ready for whatever’s next.
Relay does a good job of automatically partitioning money
